custom_expected:
EXPECTED (per spec v35, 7/1): with Manage AP/AR OFF, the sensitive customer fields (Credit Terms, Credit Limit, Default Labor Rate, Default Shop Supplies, Min and Max, Taxes, PO is Required) are hidden on the Edit Customer modal AND on the Customer Overview panel.
Step 1 OBSERVED: all 7 fields correctly hidden on the Edit Customer modal.
Step 2 BUILD-VS-SPEC DISCREPANCY: the customer Detail page overview panel still leaks 'Credit term' and 'Credit limit' to a user with AP/AR OFF (and 'Credit limit' renders as '$NaN'). Per spec these must be hidden on the overview too - flag as a build defect. Expected result stays per spec (hidden everywhere).
